name: Legion

facts.text: The arch-demon who dominates Darkness Falls.
April 2002: Mythic fixed Legion's resists, made it reclaim souls more often, fixed its reach on distant players and kept Behemoth to its own area.

Level 83, 300,000 health. Takes no damage from attackers more than 1,400 away. Heals 2.5% of its health for every player it kills ('Your soul give me new strength'), and a quarter of the Body damage it deals.
It destroys bladeturn bubbles, and after consuming five releases a soul-consuming blast; graspering souls join it at every 5% of its health.
'4 fg took him out' (Feb 2004); 'as few as about three groups' (Feb 2003).

story: Legion is the court of Darkness Falls in one body. When a demon of that kingdom dies badly, Legion takes what is left of it, and when a mortal dies in its lair it takes that too, and every one of them is still there, somewhere, in the voice. That is what Legion is: everyone it has ever eaten, speaking at once. It sits at the bottom of the kingdom and rules it not by cunning but by appetite, for every soul it takes mends its wounds, and it has never been short of souls. It cannot abide enemies at a distance; those who would hurt it must come close enough to be eaten. It eats the wards men raise against blows, and when it has eaten enough of them it opens and pours out a hunger that drinks the life of everyone near it. And as it weakens, the souls inside it try to get out, and cannot, and grasp at the living instead.
legend: Three or four groups who stand close and do not die. It cannot be hurt from more than about fourteen hundred away, so casters come in too. Every death heals it, so do not die. It eats bladeturns, and after five it blasts the whole lair, so do not feed it bubbles. Kill the graspering souls as they come out.

loremasterTopic.text: Not one demon but many, a court in one body, and it feeds on souls. Every soul it takes mends it. Stand close to it, for it cannot be hurt from afar, and do not die, for each death makes it stronger.

bookPage: The imp would not say what Legion is. It said only that Legion is everyone, and that when a demon of the court dies badly, Legion takes what is left, and it is not seen again but is somehow there, in the voice. It said that Legion speaks with every voice it has ever eaten. It said this was an honour. It did not look honoured. I gave it a second candle-end and it told me about the ledge.
